description: Core agent tools: files, shell, memory, options widgets, skills/connectors discovery, and session info.

muse.connector_search.description: Find connectors by name, alias, or the action needed (searches names, aliases, descriptions; returns name, docs path, description). Does not connect accounts or perform actions.

muse.create_options.description: For a known, bounded choice, create reply options; embed the returned embed_token unchanged in the reply. Tapping an option sends its exact text as the user's next message.

muse.db.description: Run bounded, read-only SQL SELECT queries against database-backed Muse records (transcripts, messages, agent executions, tool calls, goals, memories, scheduled work, Feed/Ideas records, artifacts, device-sync data). Prefer purpose-built tools for ordinary reads.

muse.edit.description: Edit a file by replacing exact text (first occurrence; multi-match lists other locations).

muse.exec.description: Execute a shell command. If still running after yield_ms, it backgrounds and the runtime delivers the terminal result automatically.

muse.memory_explain.description: Show where one memory came from and what replaced what (claim id, memory:// uri, or citation like MEMORY.md#L7). Read only.

muse.memory_get.description: Read a snippet from MEMORY.md, memory/**/*.md, or side-chat memory (with optional from/lines window).

muse.memory_search.description: Search saved memory and past conversations (1-3 queries; maxResults per source; minScore applies only to saved memories).

muse.nothing_to_do.description: Signal that an internal handoff or ignorable group/channel message should produce no user-visible reply.

muse.offer_preference.description: After a connector completes a task, check whether to ask about making it the preferred connector for that task category. Returns should_offer at most once per category.

muse.react_to_user_message.description: Attach an emoji reaction to the user's current message (one Unicode emoji or a supported custom reaction id).

muse.read.description: Read file contents or list directory contents (text paged by lines; images injected into context; documents converted to Markdown).

muse.session_status.description: Report conversation context-window usage (tokens filled/remaining), the serving model, and the user's local time.

muse.set_preferred.description: Save or clear the preferred skill/connector for a kind of task.

muse.skill_search.description: Search the full skill catalog (bundled + custom) by keyword (bm25) or regex. Returns names, paths, and full skill descriptions.

muse.visual_grounding.description: Locate, label, or count objects in an image (bbox/point/count; coordinates normalized 0-1000 to the exact file passed).

muse.write.description: Write content to a file (overwrite by default; append mode for incremental chunks). Overwriting existing content fails unless the file was read earlier in the conversation.
